plugins.name: value-estimates
plugins.description: Generate a value-based estimate report: pull tickets delivered in a date range from daily reports, cross-reference GitLab issues for effort, and compare to Harvest actuals.

plugins.name: youtube-playlist-builder
plugins.description: Build YouTube music playlists from a mood/likes/dislikes descriptor. Claude curates the tracklist, searches each track on YouTube, and assembles the playlist.

plugins.name: mr
plugins.description: Create a merge/pull request from a feature branch off develop: confirm branch state (no worktrees), run tests, rebase onto develop, then commit, push, open the MR, and merge only after explicit confirmation.

plugins.name: context-management
plugins.description: Keep Claude context lean and correct. optimize is the entry point: it audits context files, skills, and memory in one pass and hands findings off to whichever specialist fits — extract-to-skill, skill-registry-audit, memory-to-context, memory-hygiene.
